headline: Peruvian sol weakens to 3.451 per US dollar despite central bank intervention
summary: The Peruvian sol fell 0.52% to close at 3.451 per US dollar. Weak copper export prices and international dollar strength offset intervention attempts by the Central Reserve Bank of Peru.
why: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru actively intervenes in spot currency markets to smooth sharp fluctuations in the sol.

impacts.name: USDPEN
impacts.why: Falling copper prices and a stronger US dollar drove down the exchange rate of the Peruvian sol.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Weakening international copper prices and dollar demand pushed the Peruvian currency lower despite central bank intervention.
